highlights.title: Text notation in combination with Drag and Drop
highlights.body: Simple and robustly featured https://sequencediagram.org/instructions.html. Runs on Atlassian and available online for over 10 years and serving several thousands of daily unique users.
highlights.explanation: drawing a new message using click and drag from a participant

highlights.title: Instantly rendered
highlights.body: All parsing, processing, and drawing is done client side, all data is stored in your confluence page. Use page history to see changes or restore previous versions.
highlights.explanation: adding a new note by typing in the source area

highlights.title: Update the diagram at the same pace as you think
highlights.body: Improved efficiency when creating and working with sequence diagrams by combining text notation and drawing by clicking and dragging in the same model. Edit, add, move, delete, and change where it is easiest to do so.
highlights.explanation: moving the note by clicking and dragging it to another location

text.moreDetails:
Steps to create a new diagram:

  • Edit a page
  • Type /seq... and select SequenceDiagram.org for Confluence
  • An editor will be displayed for you to create the diagram
  • Press the blue [Save] button in the top right corner (or [Cancel] button to abort)
  • Select diagram scaling using the built in confluence functionality
  • Publish your page
  • Done!

All parsing, processing, and drawing is done client side in your browser. The diagram source data is stored in your confluence page, not on any external servers, which means that you can compare versions of your diagrams using confluence built in page history.
text.releaseNotes:
• indexing of diagram source the same way as confluence pages are indexed so that Atlassian Rovo can determine what has changed between diagram versions
  • support for coloring of fragment operator label and condition, see instructions for more info
  • bugfix: autoactivation is not handled for fragment alt else
  • bugfix: autocomplete for the second participant in messages is not working

text.releaseNotes:
• Runs on Atlassian!
    • Note: Fullscreen editor is not yet supported on Atlassian Forge but will be added as soon as available, likely mid 2026 according to Atlassian time table
  • support for named style that can be applied on any element(s), see instructions for more info
  • support for coloring only the border of fragments without also coloring the inside
  • unified styling syntax across all elements and increased compatibility with other tooling (legacy syntax remains supported)
  • bugfix: d attribute is not ended with Z for svg causing small unpainted corners
  • bugfix: rparticipant breaks export to svg
  • bugfix: message lines are not leveled in the middle of notes when using parallel
  • bugfix: styling is lost when using double click to edit for fragments
  • bugfix: syntax highlighting is wrong when there is a space next to the message arrow

This is the first version for SequenceDiagram.org for Confluence so please report any issues for prompt corrections.

Steps to create a new diagram:

  • Edit a page
  • Type /seq... and select SequenceDiagram.org for Confluence
  • A full screen editor will be displayed allowing maximum screen usage for you to create the diagram
  • Press Ctrl+S or the regular [Save] button
  • Press the blue [Back to Confluence] button in the top right corner (you will be alerted for any unsaved changes)
  • Select diagram scaling using the built in confluence supported functionallity
  • Publish your page
  • Done!
